report.summary: Patient Raymond Ellis (P-D001, 58M, dual Medicaid/MCO coverage) screened positive for food worry ("sometimes true") on 2026-04-02; food has not run out. He lives at 4200 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60624 (census tract 17031260300), a fully low-income tract with 47.7% food insecurity and 27.7% of households without a vehicle. Active problems include ESRD on dialysis, type 2 diabetes with CKD, and hypertensive CKD stage 5. Medically tailored meals eligibility form submitted; response expected within 1 business day. Three no-barrier food access options also identified.

options.name: Medically tailored meals referral
options.how_to_access: Eligibility form submitted via clinic referral (patient name, diagnoses, address, DOB on file). Clinic will contact within 1 business day to confirm qualification. Patient's ESRD/dialysis and diabetes-CKD diagnoses support eligibility.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Walk-in, no ID required. Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12–3 PM; fresh produce on Wednesdays. Located on the Northwest Side; patient should confirm proximity/transport.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Open Saturdays 9 AM–noon. Eligibility: Cook County residents (patient resides in Chicago/Cook County). No ID requirement listed.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM–8 PM; take what you need, no restrictions or eligibility screening.

fields.diagnoses: End stage renal disease (N18.6), Dependence on renal dialysis (Z99.2), Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease (E11.22), Hypertensive CKD with stage 5 CKD or ESRD (I12.0)
